title.narrative: Knowledge in motion: youth research driving better outcomes

description.narrative: As crises transform young lives in complex ways, there is need for diversely sourced analysis of the situation of youth. Also, statistics and academic knowledge need to be analyzed in conjunction with qualitative and youth-generated knowledge, perspectives, and stories. To bridge these gaps, UNESCO pairs scholar research with youth perspectives to shape effective solutions. From 2020 to 2025, 22 Youth as Researchers (YAR) initiatives enabled over 800 young people in 81 countries to produce grassroots knowledge, engaging 15,000 youth as contributors. UNESCO also convened experts and young people to advance research on youth mental health, Gen Z civic and political participation, and climate change. Looking ahead, this workplan will support the expansion of YAR’s reach, and the finalization and follow-up of the 1st Global Youth Outlook on youth mental health in times of crises and a global study on Gen Z.
